description: The Autonomous University of Tamaulipas publishes synthetic technical, economic and environmental variables for nine urban mitigation strategies. The Mendeley Data page describes residential, commercial and transport measures, 81 market and behavioural scenarios, and Monte Carlo simulations with 135,000 draws per strategy. Outputs include marginal abatement cost distributions and financial or environmental backfire probabilities under rebound assumptions. The synthetic coverage is not tied to a measured city or observation period; source parameters combine literature and case-study inputs. Mendeley Data provides version one freely under CC BY 4.0. These scenarios can test energy-demand or urban decarbonization models under uncertain costs and behavioural response. The results depend on assumed probability distributions and rebound parameters, so they should not be treated as observed local performance. The repository describes Python steps and fixed seeds, but file formats and full reproduction were not verified. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: A Synthetic Dataset for Decarbonization Policy: Integrating Monte Carlo Simulations and Rebound Effects
